rules.content:
title: Mshta Launched With Remote HTA URL
id: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
status: experimental
description: Detects mshta.exe started with an http or https URL on its command line,
  as used by the DuskRelay loader to fetch and run a remote HTA file.
references:
- urn:atidep:INJD-06
author: single-prompt
date: 2026/10/02
tags:
- attack.stealth
- attack.t1218.005
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: \mshta.exe
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - http://
    - https://
  condition: selection_img and selection_cli
falsepositives:
- Legitimate internal HTA applications hosted on an intranet web server
level: high
